zh.title: 西南航空調整2026年第三季航線裁撤68條並新增67條
zh.summary: 西南航空規劃於2026年第三季裁撤68條航線，同時將新增67條航線。
body: 根據航空新聞網站Simple Flying報導，美國西南航空（Southwest Airlines）規劃於2026年第三季調整航網。西南航空預計在該季度裁撤68條航線，同時針對營運需求重新評估整體航線布局與配置。
在實施68條航線裁撤的同時，西南航空亦計畫於2026年第三季新增67條航線。這項航線調整策略涵蓋航線裁撤與新航線開闢，反映該航空公司在相關季度的航班調配規劃。
整體而言，西南航空於2026年第三季的航線調整包含68條航線削減與67條航線增加，使航線總數保持相對平衡，並重塑其營運航網布局。

en.title: Southwest Airlines to Cut 68 Routes and Add 67 in Q3 2026
en.summary: Southwest Airlines will cut 68 routes and add 67 others in the third quarter of 2026.
body: Southwest Airlines is planning significant network route changes for the third quarter of 2026. According to reporting by aviation news outlet Simple Flying, the United States carrier is scheduled to cut 68 routes from its flight network during Q3 2026.

At the same time, Southwest Airlines will add 67 other routes to its network during the third quarter of 2026. The simultaneous route cuts and route additions represent a broad restructuring of the carrier's schedule and operational planning for the period.
The overall network adjustments involve 68 route reductions alongside 67 new route additions, balancing the route cuts with new services in the third quarter of 2026.

sources.name: Simple Flying — Southwest Airlines Cuts Massive 68 Routes: See All Changes…

facts.claim: Southwest Airlines is cutting 68 routes and adding 67 other routes for the third quarter of 2026.
facts.sourceQuote: Southwest Airlines cuts 68 routes for Q3 2026 while adding 67 others.

zh.title: 美國航空13億美元申報揭示其後頭等艙機隊策略
zh.summary: 美國航空申報13億美元債務；揭示未來包含更多A321XLR之機隊策略
body: 根據航空媒體 Simple Flying 於 2026 年 8 月 24 日發布的報導，美國航空已提交了一份總額達 13 億美元的新債務申報文件。這份新發布的財務申報透露了該航空公司機隊策略的重要資訊，特別是關於其「後頭等艙」（post-First Class）機隊的規劃細節。
這份 13 億美元的債務申報文件詳細說明了美國航空所謂的「後頭等艙」策略。該策略包含計劃引進更多 A321XLR 飛機，以及配置更多優質艙位的 777 飛機。根據申報文件內容，這些調整預計將為該航空公司帶來全面轉型後的跨大西洋機隊。

en.title: American Airlines Debt Filing Reveals New Post-First Class Fleet Strategy
en.summary: American Airlines submits a $1.3 billion debt filing revealing its new fleet strategy.
body: According to a report published by Simple Flying on August 24, 2026, American Airlines has submitted a new debt filing totaling $1.3 billion. This newly released financial filing reveals key insights into the carrier's fleet strategy, specifically regarding its post-First Class fleet plans. The report outlines details from the filed debt documents.

The $1.3 billion debt filing outlines what is described as American Airlines' post-First strategy. This strategy includes plans for more A321XLRs and premium-heavy 777s. According to the document details, these changes are expected to result in a transformed transatlantic fleet for the operator.

sources.name: Simple Flying — What American Airlines' New $1.3 Billion Debt Filing Reveal…

facts.claim: American Airlines has submitted a new $1.3 billion debt filing.
The filing outlines a post-First strategy featuring more A321XLRs, premium-heavy 777s, and a transformed transatlantic fleet.
facts.sourceQuote: reveals its post-First strategy: more A321XLRs, premium-heavy 777s and a transformed transatlantic fleet

zh.title: 德事隆航空任命羅霍夫為新任執行長
zh.summary: 德事隆航空宣布新執行長；接替退休的Ron Draper
body: Textron Aviation（德事隆航空）於2026年8月24日宣布，布萊恩·羅霍夫（Brian Rohloff）將自2026年8月31日起出任公司執行長（CEO）一職。
現任執行長Ron Draper在任職超過27年後宣布退休，其中包括過去8年領導Textron Aviation。
根據公司說法，Rohloff此前在Textron Aviation的職務包括品質副總裁、銷售副總裁，以及Citation XLS+和Citation X的高級產品總監。
Textron的總裁暨執行長Lisa Atherton表示：「Brian是一位久經考驗的領導者，對我們的業務、產品、客戶和產業有深入的了解。」

en.title: Textron Aviation appoints Brian Rohloff as new CEO as Ron Draper retires
en.summary: Textron Aviation names Brian Rohloff CEO; Ron Draper retires
body: Textron Aviation has confirmed the appointment of Brian Rohloff as its new Chief Executive Officer, effective August 31, 2026.
The announcement was made on August 24, 2026, by its parent company Textron, following the retirement plans of current boss Ron Draper.
Draper is retiring after more than 27 years with Textron, including the past eight years leading Textron Aviation.
According to the company, Rohloff's previous roles at Textron Aviation include Vice President of Quality, Vice President of Sales and Senior Product Director for the Citation XLS+ and Citation X.

Lisa Atherton, Textron's President and CEO, stated that Rohloff is a proven leader with a deep understanding of the business and industry, adding that he has built strong leadership and trusted relationships across multiple functions.
